title: Orchestrate onboarding DAG and release assembler for synthesized perf profiles
author: Diego Morales
description: Motivation: onboarding several new open models exposed a gap in how we compose metadata transforms, perf fragments, and release notes into a single deterministic model version artifact. This PR introduces an onboarding DAG (graph runner) that composes validators, normalizers, profile synthesizers, and a release-assembler that produces canonical changelog/release-note entries for each model version. What changed: - new onboarding/graph package (DAG runner, node interfaces, light scheduler) - deterministic version hash: canonical serializer + version salt derived from provenance - perf profile synthesizer: merges infra benchmark fragments, manual annotations, and quantization notes into a single profile document with provenance traces - release-assembler: template-driven changelog entries + optional GitHub release draft action - CLI hooks and GitHub Action integration (onboard:run, onboard:migrate) - migration shim to translate existing model profiles to the new canonical format - docs: onboarding guide, schema reference, and migration notes Checklist: - [x] Add DAG runner and node interfaces - [x] Implement deterministic hashing and serializer - [x] Add perf profile synthesizer and provenance fields - [x] Implement release-assembler and GitHub Action - [x] Add unit+integration tests and CI jobs - [x] Add docs and migration guide - [x] Update SDK examples to consume synthesized profiles Backwards compatibility and migration: existing profile documents are converted via a one-time migration CLI (onboard:migrate) that emits a preview bundle and a dry-run mode. We keep compatibility by preserving legacy fields under a legacy_metadata namespace and by allowing consumers to opt into the new canonical version hash. Performance expectations: profile synthesis is a CPU-bound transformation that adds ~15–40ms per onboarding job in our benchmark harness (depends on profile size). Related work: ENG-4122, ENG-4198, PM-703. See inline commits and tests for microbenchmarks and graphs.

release_notes: Introduces an onboarding DAG runner that composes validators, normalizers, and synthesizers into a deterministic model artifact.
Adds deterministic canonical serializer and version hashing to produce stable model version identifiers.
Adds a perf profile synthesizer that merges infra fragments, annotations, and quantization notes with provenance tracing.
Adds a release-assembler that emits changelog entries and integrates with GitHub Actions to draft releases.
Includes a migration CLI (onboard:migrate) with dry-run and mapping table output to ease transition for existing profiles.
